text: 中国人民银行研究局局长王信指出，近年来，全球算力中心直接耗水规模迅速攀升。具体到我国，目前我国算力中心用水量占全国用水总量的比重还不高，但结构性问题已经逐渐凸显。针对人工智能和算力发展中的水资源问题，可以从算力发展本身以及绿色金融、可持续金融等方面采取相应措施：一是强化水资源计量监测、数据核验和信息披露；二是推广节水技术，完善绿色数据中心资源效率评价机制；三是更好发挥水价的资源配置作用；四是发挥绿色金融作用，支持人工智能与水资源协同发展。（金融时报）
text_en: Wang Xin, Director of the Research Bureau of the People's Bank of China, pointed out that in recent years, the scale of direct water consumption by global computing power centers has risen rapidly. In China specifically, the proportion of water used by computing power centers in total national water consumption is not yet high, but structural problems have gradually become prominent. In response to the water resource issues in AI and computing power development, corresponding measures can be taken from the aspects of computing power development itself as well as green finance and sustainable finance: first, strengthen water resource measurement, monitoring, data verification and information disclosure; second, promote water-saving technologies and improve the resource efficiency evaluation mechanism for green data centers; third, better leverage the role of water pricing in resource allocation; fourth, leverage the role of green finance to support the coordinated development of AI and water resources. (Financial Times)
